scope: Only completed, summarized supplemental runs containing PB-owned sources. SourceCommit is taken from each sidecar. No uncommitted author fix, setup-final, future or release build substituted here.
limits: The compact series requests browser color preference. Light public rendering is valid for a published explicitly light site. Those files do not certify a dark UI. The separate published-system-theme SSR reader run has rootColorScheme=dark and observed dark surfaces; its after state does not establish dark login/share-magazine rendering.
PB-018 modern capabilities and the legacy checkbox branch are distinct. Direct grant decisions, physical OS sheet/file chooser and external services are not inferred from still images.

The old failed cover-picker attempts remain excluded. Only subsequent actual open nonempty picker checks receive a verdict. The separate author patch and integrated setup-final are not assessed as this supplemental source.
